description: Lists every open court time at one bookable CourtsApp facility on one day, grouped by indoor or outdoor and surface, with per-hour prices and a booking link for each. The CourtsApp facility card calls this to show a club's times on its profile; it is not needed to find courts for a user, which search_courts does (it returns the first few times per club). Needs the facility's id (from search_courts or get_facility_details). The date is optional and defaults to today where the facility is (tomorrow when nothing is left today); sport defaults to the facility's first sport.

date.description: Day to list, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today where the facility is.

facilityId.description: The facility's id (a UUID), as returned by search_courts or get_facility_details.

sport.description: Sport slug or name, e.g. "pickleball" or "Table Tennis". Defaults to the facility's first sport.

name: get_facility_times

discountedPrice.description: Price per hour after any discount, in cents.

originalPrice.description: List price per hour, in cents.

startTime.description: Start time in the club's local time, HH:MM (24-hour).

url.description: The CourtsApp booking page for this time.

rolledOver.description: True when no date was given and nothing was left today, so this is tomorrow.

title: Get Facility Times
